scope: Synthetic mathematical and implementation invariants. No anatomical validation, browser performance measurement, or full-volume reprocessing.

reviewedSemantics.sign: NBE1 bit 1 is field >= threshold, confirmed against edge_codec.py; filtering labels foreground tissue, not background cavities.
reviewedSemantics.cellSuppression: Any two foreground corners of one cube are 26-adjacent, so a cell cannot contain both a retained and rejected foreground component under this classifier.
reviewedSemantics.border: Whole-tile components touching any outer sample face are retained; internal rendering-piece boundaries do not affect classification.
reviewedSemantics.shape: Square-root ratio of regularized covariance eigenvalues, with 1/12 sample-support variance. This is a principal-axis spread ratio, not a raw eigenvalue ratio.
reviewedSemantics.geometry: Positions are unchanged for every allocated vertex. Normals are unchanged for vertices referenced by each selected face subset; unused normals may differ.

checks.name: Eight-piece exact subset and geometry retention
checks.unusedNormalScope: Unreferenced vertex normals need not match; no retained or rejected rendered vertex normal differed.

limitations: Small compact real tissue can meet the rejection rule; connectivity and shape do not establish anatomical truth.
Attached clutter survives this component-only filter.
PCA protects globally anisotropic rods and flat sheets, not every curved strand or sheet.
The 0.4 mm gate describes inclusive sample support, not a strict decoded-surface diameter.
removedVolumeMm3 is sample count times voxel volume, not an independently measured anatomical tissue volume.
The synthetic partition fixture is 33 cubed; separate cached-data verification covers production 129-cubed tiles.
No claim is made that all unused packed-normal bytes or all output buffer bytes remain identical.
